In every pose there is exactly ONE staff and two hands. Do not redesign or change any other pose. Preserve transparent alpha, no background, no shadow, no text.

Generate a NEW compact 2 by 2 transparent sprite sheet of ONLY FOUR WALKING poses. Top row: FRONT THREE-QUARTER walk toward screen lower-right. These are TWO DISTINCT consecutive gait keyframes for each view: LEFT column is wide-stride CONTACT, BOTH legs visible spread front/back with the screen-right foot far forward and screen-left foot far back. RIGHT column is OPPOSITE CONTACT: screen-LEFT foot now far forward and screen-right foot far back; the feet MUST exchange positions through a walking stride. The torso stays facing the SAME direction between columns, do NOT horizontally mirror the whole character or reverse the staff, only swap which leg leads. Clear unequal opposing leg silhouettes, not two copies of a one-legged hop. Staff held steady diagonally at waist in both hands during walking, no doubled staff. Robe hem reveals both feet. Keep the established detailed clean hand-drawn cel-shaded design, consistent face/costume. Full bodies and staff in each cell with15% transparent margins, no text, no floor, no shadow, no effects.
